——————————
他迷迷糊糊地醒了过来。
四周只有一望无际的森林。他眨巴了好几下眼睛，然后破口大骂。
“我他妈这到底在哪儿？！
先是被车撞了。
然后那些混蛋医护人员还没把我送到医院就又出车祸了。
接着派直升机来救援，结果直升机也坠毁了！
你们能不能靠谱点，混蛋们！派你们那些脏兮兮的小喽啰来救人之前，先把自己那摊子事儿整明白行不行！”
他精疲力竭，动弹不得。只能听到茂密森林里的声音。没有燃烧的声音，也没有人们痛苦的呻吟。一片“寂静”，诡异的寂静。
“他们不会把我扔这儿不管了吧……对吧？”
一想到可能被抛弃，他就吓得直冒汗。倒不是因为会孤身一人，而是因为他会流血而死——嗯？他不觉得疼，也不觉得肠子流了一地。只是觉得……累？
他满心疑惑，低头看去。看不到自己的下半身。
“哎呀，糟糕！难怪我觉得累，我整个下半身都没了，该死的！”
他咒骂着把他弄到这儿来的人，却还是试着活动四肢。能活动，他很快就想用手擦擦脸——
他整个人僵住了，直勾勾地盯着那毛茸茸的爪子。脑子一片空白，不知道该想些什么……
[系统启动]
他呆呆地看着眼前那熟悉又陌生的漂浮文字。
状态系统
……

他茫然地盯着这些文字，灵魂仿佛都要出窍了。
[系统已完全启动，将在未来协助您。]
“好极了……太棒了……你觉得我会在乎吗？！我现在成了个毛茸茸的家伙！不！还不止！我成了个该死的动物！还有这2点生命值是怎么回事？！你觉得我是个笑话吗？！一颗小石子就能要了我的命！”
他发泄着心中的愤懑，因为他对“角色扮演游戏”系统再熟悉不过了。这可没给他带来什么好兆头。
[本系统会助您变强，请勿担忧，被选中者。]
“我不想被选中！我只想躺在医院里，无忧无虑地养伤！”
[那不可能。]
“哼！所以你们就绑架了我的灵魂，把它扔在这鬼地方，还美其名曰‘变强’，好像我会在乎你们的理由似的，把我送回去！”
此刻，他在心里朝着空荡荡的四周大喊大叫，可惜，情况只会越来越糟……
[您的身体已在火中丧生，无法送您回去。]
“……嗯？”
他的脑子突然清醒了些，盯着眼前的文字。
[您的心智已受损，所以您记不得太多，但这是您的愿望。]
[我的主人，他是仁慈的神，在####的条件下，允许您梦想成真。]
[因此，您得到了所期望的一切，无法再回到原来的世界。]
content_en:
[Adopted father and mother, add a bookshelf, thank you for your support. 】
——————————
He woke up dazedly.
There is only endless forest all around. He blinked several times and then cursed.
“Where the hell am I?!
First he was hit by a car.
Then those asshole paramedics had another car accident before they could even send me to the hospital.
Then a helicopter was sent to rescue, but the helicopter also crashed!
Could you please be more reliable, assholes! Before sending those dirty minions of yours to rescue people, how about you sort out your own mess first? "
He was exhausted and unable to move. Only the sounds of the dense forest could be heard. There was no sound of burning, no groans of pain from people. There was "silence", an eerie silence.
"They won't just leave me here...right?"
The thought of possible abandonment made him sweat with fear. Not because he would be alone, but because he would bleed to death—huh? He didn't feel any pain, nor did he feel like his intestines were leaking all over the floor. Just feel...tired?
Confused, he looked down. Can't see my lower body.
"Ouch, crap! No wonder I feel tired, my whole lower body is gone, damn it!"
He cursed whoever brought him here, but still tried to move his limbs. Able to move, he soon wanted to wipe his face with his hands——
He froze, staring straight at the furry paws. My mind is blank, I don't know what to think...
[System startup]
He stared blankly at the familiar yet unfamiliar floating words in front of him.
state system
…
He stared blankly at these words, as if his soul was about to leave his body.
[The system is fully activated and will assist you in the future. ]
"Great... great... do you think I care?! I'm a furry guy now! No! Not just that! I'm a damn animal! And what's with these 2 health points?! Do you think I'm a joke?! A pebble can kill me!"
He vented his anger because he was all too familiar with the "role-playing game" system. This didn't bode well for him.
[This system will help you become stronger, don’t worry, the chosen one. ]
"I don't want to be selected! I just want to lie in the hospital and recuperate without any worries!"
[That's impossible. ]
"Hmph! So you kidnapped my soul, threw it in this damn place, and called it 'becoming stronger', as if I would care about your reasons for sending me back!"
At this moment, he was yelling at the empty surroundings in his heart. Unfortunately, the situation would only get worse...
[Your body has perished in the fire and I cannot send you back. ]
"...huh?"
His mind suddenly became clearer and he stared at the words in front of him.
[Your mind is damaged so you don't remember much, but that's your wish. ]
[My Master, who is a merciful God, allows your dreams to come true under #### conditions. ]
[So you get everything you expected and can't go back to the original world. ]
